description: Start building a new app, website or game on SPOE from a description. kind "website" makes a plain HTML site (fast, can be published at name.spoe.dev); kind "app" makes a full-stack Next.js, Fastify and Postgres app; kind "game" makes a browser game (Phaser for 2D, Three.js for 3D) that plays on a computer and a phone, can be published at name.spoe.dev, and borrows the mechanics of any games it is asked to be like, never their names, characters or art. A second AI from another model family reviews the change. Costs credits from the account: estimated first, charged when the build finishes, never if it fails. Returns the studio link to watch it and the project id for app_status.

description.description: What to build, in plain words: who it is for, the pages, what it should do. For a game: the kind of game, games it should be like, the controls and the goal.

kind.description: website (plain HTML), app (full stack) or game (a browser game). Default website.

name.description: A short name for the project.

name: create_app
title: Build a new app or website
